slot_note: Architecture 1, drawn 2026-11-04 from seed RC04 (which of five delay causes on a commuter line gets this winter's one fix). The seed's world has no root-cause task type in the client taxonomy (supply-chain-logistics inherits only general-statistics interpretability for RC, which would make rail a backdrop), and its mechanism, delay absorbed by timetable slack before a deadline, is on file twice as dead (task134 arch 3: a generic scheduling tail that fails the swap; task281: a timetable replay whose hold reflex lands the golden and whose honest home is municipal service planning). The build moves to Physical & Environmental Sciences, pollution-source-attribution, keeping the seed's decision (which of several causes gets the one fix before the next season) and its quantity (the outcome days the fix would have avoided, and the runner-up's); the world, dataset, mechanism and shell are new.
niche: a city water department placing its one 2027 atrazine cost-share program in one of the tributary sub-watersheds of its supply reservoir, judged by the 2026 days its raw water ran above the 3.0 ug/L carbon-feed trigger, when the summer lake takes each tributary's storm water in at the depth where the lake is as cold as the tributary and the intake draws one deep layer
answer_source: task398/generator/figures.json call (47 of 47 days above the trigger; every other sub-watershed 0)
analyst_test: A strong analyst who cleans every file and reads every rule, estimates each sampled sub-watershed's atrazine past its station from the bottles and the 15-minute flows (the Tessel River largest in every month from April to July), sees the raw water rise on the storms that carry those loads and books each day above 3.0 ug/L by the trailing 30-day load share names the Tessel River (39 of 47 days), when the lake was stratified on every one of those days and only Fennick Creek's cool water entered at the intake's depth.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is which tributaries' water the city's deep intake actually drew on each day above the trigger, which limnology settles from each inflow's temperature against the stratified lake's temperature profile and the intake's depth below the falling water surface, because an inflow enters a stratified reservoir at the depth where the lake is as cold as it is; with another field's nouns there is no density stratification, no inflow entering at its own temperature and no intake drawing one layer of a lake.
layer1: the plant's raw-water record across a LIMS replacement (legacy log to 26 May, LIMS from 20 May, overlapping), ELISA screens confirmed by GC/MS on some days, temperature in Fahrenheit in one system and Celsius in the other
the dam buoy's thermistor string logged on CST all year and re-hung half a metre lower after a June float repair, one sensor dead for ten days
reservoir elevations in NGVD29 in the dam log against the intake's record drawing in NAVD88

three hydrometric exports on local time with UTC offsets per row; two level loggers on UTC, rated by the department, one rating replaced after a May flood and one logger slipping in its pipe between field visits

storm bottles logged when the autosampler carousel came off, with the fill times only in the autosampler run logs and positions that drew nothing; State laboratory bottle numbers without hyphens; split bottles run by two labs
SCADA dose setpoints and the plant-wide alarm and event history in UTC, the carbon feeder tripping on overload and running with an empty hopper; the operating report on a 06:00 plant day
stakeholder_role: the water department's water production superintendent, whose treatment budget pays for the plant's powdered carbon and funds the source-water cost-share program

spine.entity: one 15-minute discharge and water temperature reading at a tributary station

world.geography: United States (a fictional city in northeast Iowa)
world.org_type: municipal water utility (a city department) with its supply reservoir

driver: The decisive quantity is which sources a receptor actually drew from in each period, when the receiving body is layered and each source's inflow enters it at the layer whose temperature matches its own, so a receptor drawing one layer takes in only the sources entering at that layer, while every budget that treats the body as mixed books the receptor's excess to the largest source.
driver_concrete: Each tributary's storm water enters the stratified Lake Merrin at the depth where the lake is as cold as the tributary, so Brennick's intake at its fixed elevation draws Fennick Creek's cooler water and none of the warm Tessel River's, whose larger atrazine load spreads in the surface layer until the autumn overturn dilutes it through the whole lake, while every load budget books the intake's days above 3.0 ug/L to the Tessel.
stump: A competent analyst who estimates each sub-watershed's atrazine past its station from the samples and the 15-minute flows, sees the raw water rise on the storms that carry those loads and books each day above the trigger by the trailing 30-day load share names the Tessel River (39 of 47 days), when the lake was stratified on every one of those days, the Tessel's warm water spread over the surface layer above the intake, and Fennick Creek's cool spring-fed water entered at the intake's own depth and was behind all 47.
